## Spouse

- Dependent children until they marry or reach age 19; or age 25 if they are full-time students at an accredited secondary school, college, university or nursing school and the child is unmarried & dependent on the employee for care & support. Full-time student coverage is to be to age 25 or for six months after leaving school, whichever is earlier.

• Dependent children beyond age 25 who have a physical or mental condition that prevents them from working.
